tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The Charisma crimson of the mark (charisma.rocks --brand). Same in both themes. Brand moments only: the logo disc, the cover, OG art. Never a button or a state.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark: red-tinted black, between charisma.rocks's black body and its #170202 background. Light: Zesty's #F7F7F7.

tokens.name: bg-glow
tokens.usage: Radial hero glow behind the mark or a hero object (charisma.rocks hero). Dark only; the light value is fully transparent on purpose, because the Bitcoin theme has no glows.

tokens.name: texture
tokens.usage: Lines of the 32px grid texture behind heroes (charisma.rocks). Dark only; the light value is fully transparent on purpose.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 12px edge bar under a hero and along the bottom of OG images (Zesty). Light only; the dark value is fully transparent on purpose.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Panes nested inside a card: the swap card's pay and receive panes, inputs inside a dialog. Dark is simple-swap's bg-white/[0.02].

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, list rows and the header's icon tiles. Dark is simple-swap's bg-white/[0.03] (its most used fill); light is Zesty's white card.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for cards, rows and quiet buttons (simple-swap hover:bg-white/[0.08]).

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row or chip, e.g. the chosen token in the token picker. Dark is bg-white/[0.12]; light is an alias of accent-soft.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Opaque layers above the page: dialogs, menus, toasts, the token picker sheet. Opaque so text stays legible over the overlay.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the token picker. Dark is simple-swap's bg-black/80 with backdrop-blur-xl; light is a lighter scrim.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default borders and hairlines on cards, panes and inputs. Dark is border-white/[0.08]; light is Zesty's #E5E5E5.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Inner dividers and the swap card's nested panes (border-white/[0.06]).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and selected borders. Light is Zesty's 2px black border on a chosen side card. Dark is border-white/[0.25] and only 2.1:1 on bg, so never make it the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, amounts and primary text, on bg, any surface and surface-raised (dark ≥16.5:1, light ≥17:1).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary labels, on bg and every surface (dark ≥10.5:1, light ≥10:1). Light is Zesty's #3D3D3D.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, placeholders, USD hints under amounts, on bg and every surface (dark ≥5.7:1, light ≥6.2:1). Light is Zesty's #5C5C5C.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and decorative separators only, at 3–3.5:1. Never use it for text people need to read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The primary action fill: the swap CTA, Connect wallet, the active step. Dark is charisma.rocks crimson; light is a deeper Stacks orange (#EC3D03) so white labels read at 4.0:1, while #FC6432 itself stays on chrome (chrome-accent) and the edge bar. One accent fill per view. 3.7:1 against the light paper.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for accent buttons: a step deeper, so the white label stays legible.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: white in both realms (6.2:1 on crimson, 4.0:1 on the light orange).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The accent as text: links, the app name in a lockup, 'Share on X', selected tab labels. Works on bg, every surface and accent-soft (dark ≥5.8:1, light ≥5.1:1). Dark is charisma.rocks --brand-light; light is Zesty's --z-orange-text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent-text: the active chip, an info callout, the selected token row in light. Light is Zesty's peach #FFF4EF.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of an accent-soft element. Light is Zesty's #FFD9C9.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The header and footer bars. They stay dark in both themes: the light theme's black bar is the Bitcoin/Stacks signature (Zesty header).

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Text and the wordmark on chrome (≥17:1).

tokens.name: on-chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Nav links and secondary text on chrome (≥7.6:1).

tokens.name: chrome-accent
tokens.usage: The app name in the header lockup and the active nav link, on chrome (≥6.3:1).

tokens.name: blaze
tokens.usage: Blaze, the instant subnet: the subnet pill, the Blaze flame on a token logo, the Triggered mode dot, Blaze Wallet. Replaces simple-swap's purple subnet colour so Blaze reads as one brand with the Blaze Wallet's teal. On bg and every surface (dark ≥10:1, light ≥5.1:1).

tokens.name: blaze-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind blaze text in a subnet pill (blaze on it: dark 9.2:1, light 4.9:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Filled orders, price up, 'Minimum guaranteed', positive change. Always paired with a word or icon. Light is Zesty's green #1B7A3A.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text, and the 'recently updated' ring on an order card.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed transactions, price down, high price impact. Always paired with a word or icon. Light is a true red so errors never read as the orange accent; Zesty's #8F310A is retired.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text in an error note or toast.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Paused bots, medium price impact, 'check your balance'. Paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: blaze-fill
tokens.usage: Solid Blaze fills that carry text or an icon: the subnet swap button, the flame badge on a token. White (on-fill) on it is 5.5:1. Use blaze for teal text and marks.

tokens.name: success-fill
tokens.usage: Solid success fills that carry text or an icon (a filled check, an Execute button). White on it is 5.0:1.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Solid danger fills that carry text or an icon (Withdraw, Cancel all). White on it is 4.8:1 dark, 6.6:1 light.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blaze-fill, success-fill and danger-fill: always white.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Game rewards: lottery winning balls, leaderboard rank 1, jackpots, the health bar's full end. An RPG flourish, so never use it for a financial state (light is 4.9:1 on bg).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px ring with a 2px offset in bg colour, at ≥5.1:1 on every surface. Light was Zesty's orange, darkened because #FC6432 is 2.8:1.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Open-source pools and routing that belong to no one and work for everyone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We sell your ZEST for you when it rises.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Swap from your wallet, or off chain in an instant.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, table headers, stat labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: num-xl
styles.usage: Stat-tile values and the swap amount input.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Amounts, prices and balances in rows.

type.familiesUsage: sans is per realm: Ysabeau Infant's storybook letterforms are the RPG voice by night; Matter (Zesty, Stacks Workshop) is the Bitcoin voice by day. Matter ships 400 and 500 only, so the light realm turns off weight synthesis: anything bolder renders as Medium, the Stacks look. mono (DM Mono) is the same in both.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, button icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (mobile), list gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (p-5, the source default).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards; swap pane spacing (mb-6).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding inside apps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding, the header height (h-16).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tip-jar amounts, small inputs, mode-toggle items (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, toasts, stat tiles (rounded-xl).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panes, dialogs, the token picker search (rounded-2xl).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, status badges, avatars and token logos.

shadow.note: Dark elevates with glass and a crimson bloom; light elevates with hairlines and almost no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: The one accent-filled CTA in a view.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, toasts and the token picker sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A 1px top highlight on dark glass cards; flat in light.
